description: Re-price a specific room live against the supplier before checkout (no booking, no charge). Use the `offerRef` and price/currency from `get_rooms`. Returns the authoritative grand total, a `rateValidUntil` timestamp, and any taxes/fees.

ref.description: Hotel `ref` from `search_hotels` (e.g. 'TBO:1402689'). Alternative to supplierCode + supplierHotelId.

supplierCode.description: Supplier code (from `search_hotels`). Required if `ref` is omitted.

supplierHotelId.description: Supplier hotel id (from `search_hotels`). Required if `ref` is omitted.

supplierRoomId.description: Bookable room/rate id from the chosen room in `search_hotels`.

totalPrice.description: The room's price from `search_hotels` — the TOTAL for the whole stay, not a nightly rate (used to detect price changes).

name: get_checkout_quote
title: Get checkout quote
